schema.text: When you travel by car, does poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned buildings, graffiti, broken infrastructure) make you feel less secure?

ar.#When you travel by car, does poor maint: عند التنقل بالسيارة، هل يُضعف سوء الصيانة (مثل المباني المهجورة أو الكتابة على الجدران أو البنية التحتية المتضررة) شعورك بالأمان؟

de.#When you travel by car, does poor maint: Fühlen Sie sich bei Autofahrten durch schlechte Instandhaltung (z. B. verlassene Gebäude, Graffiti, kaputte Infrastruktur) weniger sicher?

en.#When you travel by car, does poor maint: When you travel by car, does poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned buildings, graffiti, broken infrastructure) make you feel less secure?

fa.#When you travel by car, does poor maint: هنگام سفر با خودرو، آیا نگهداری ضعیف (مثلاً ساختمان‌های متروکه، دیوارنویسی، زیرساخت‌های خراب) باعث می‌شود احساس امنیت کمتری کنید؟

fr.#When you travel by car, does poor maint: Lorsque vous vous déplacez en voiture, vous sentez-vous moins en sécurité à cause d’un mauvais entretien (par ex. bâtiments abandonnés, graffitis, infrastructures dégradées) ?

hu.#When you travel by car, does poor maint: Autós utazás közben kevésbé érzi magát biztonságban a rossz karbantartás (pl. elhagyott épületek, graffitik, tönkrement infrastruktúra) miatt?

it.#When you travel by car, does poor maint: Quando viaggi in auto, la scarsa manutenzione (es. edifici abbandonati, graffiti, infrastrutture rotte) ti fa sentire meno al sicuro?

tr.#When you travel by car, does poor maint: Arabayla yolculuk ederken bakımsızlık (örn. terk edilmiş binalar, grafitiler, bozuk altyapı) kendinizi daha az güvende hissetmenize neden oluyor mu?
